title: Join Anchorage’s Fur Rondy celebrations
description: For Fur Rondy, downtown Anchorage becomes a winter festival: sled-dog teams race through city streets, snow sculptures grow near Ship Creek, and neighbors gather for parades and playful local events. Pick a few moments rather than trying to see everything. The mix of serious mushing, homemade tradition, and cold-weather humor makes the city feel especially itself.
teaser: See sled-dog racing and snow art at Fur Rondy.
goodToKnow: Check the current Fur Rondy program and choose the events and viewing spots that suit your pace.
whyItMightDelightYou: It is a festival that lets you meet Anchorage through the traditions its residents still enjoy together.
